RBI Opens Dollar Window for Oil Firms Amidst Rupee Pressure

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has established a special window for oil companies to purchase dollars, aiming to alleviate pressure on the Indian rupee. This measure is part of a two-pronged strategy by the RBI to support the rupee, which also includes curbs on forex derivatives. The initiative is intended to help oil firms meet their foreign exchange needs.
